name: Gengai
source:
A disestablishmentarian clergyman who leads a militia of people who don't belong to either Clustania or Archia.
He lives in Great Fang, and exerts great leadership and charisma by empowering the people with his eloquence and strength.
He's such a radical activist.
Tatsumi's V-Boarding technique was passed down from him.

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/atq/]official site[/url]]
